note: Host-project overlay of the DevGate secret-allowlist baseline (.devgate/.guardrails/secret-allowlist.json). Projects EXTEND via this overlay, never by editing the submodule baseline (overlay-not-fork). Entries here disposition lab-simulator demo credentials and study-guide examples — never real credentials. The working-tree scan (gitleaks --no-git) reports ABSOLUTE paths; the history scan (gitleaks --log-opts=--all) reports repo-relative paths. Both forms must be allowed to cover working-tree and history findings. Entries are path-scoped because the gate matches (rule, path); per-line duplicates recorded on 2026-09-24 were merged 2026-11-23, and every path is repo-relative so a CI checkout matches the same entries a workstation does.

entry_shape.rule: the scanner's rule id (RuleID in gitleaks JSON)
entry_shape.path: repo-relative path of the file the finding is in
entry_shape.reason: why this occurrence is not a credential (required)
entry_shape.commit: the commit the occurrence was dispositioned at (informational)
entry_shape.recorded: when and how it was established (informational)
